entries.expectedBasis: Editorial estimate for sweetened Wanglaoji/Walovi herbal tea. A Yami community tasting describes tea fragrance, herbal flavor and a little sweetness; a Reddit firsthand canned-drink account compares it to slightly herbal iced tea. These are Wanglaoji product-family reviews, not verified tastings of this exact US WALOVI 24-can listing. Market formulations and perceived sweetness may differ. The existing seven-axis scores remain lower-confidence editorial estimates, not measured sensory-panel results.

changes.basis: Wanglaoji canned-tea family: named Japanese firsthand import tasting (October 12, 2024) criticizes excessive sweetness; existing Yami and Reddit tastings retained, the latter dated from original February 16, 2025 post timestamp. Original Japanese quote, not note.com AI translation. These reports do not establish the exact US WALOVI 24-can listing formulation. Seven editorial taste axes preserved; no health claims adopted.

entries.expectedBasis: Editorial estimate for Coconut Palm ready-to-drink coconut milk, not cooking coconut milk. Trang’s Weee community ambassador post describes a strong coconut aroma and slight sweetness; the post links both 1 L cartons and cans. A separate Reddit firsthand review of the canned version describes a thinner, milky drink with a mild coconut taste. These are subjective consumer accounts; the canned review is product-family evidence, not a tasting of this exact 1 L pack. Existing seven-axis scores are retained and are not measured panel results.
